title: Indian Railway Stations with Geo-coordinates (भारतीय रेल स्टेशन — भू-निर्देशांक के साथ)
description: 8,484 Indian Railways stations with WGS84 latitude/longitude, station code, station name (English IRCTC uppercase), pre-2017 IR station category (A1/A/B/C/D/E/F by annual passenger earnings), post-2017 NSG/HG/SG category code (where present), division code, and state. Sourced from namastevis/india-railway-stations (CC0-1.0 — Public Domain Dedication). Complements hi-railway-stations (3,343 stations, IRCTC NTES, with trains[] field, no coordinates) by adding 5,141 additional stations and contributing lat/lon for all 8,484.
